field_edits.updated_text: Five non‑rib‑bearing lumbar vertebral bodies are identified. There is mild levoconvex lumbar scoliosis. Lumbar vertebral body heights are maintained without acute compression deformity. Alignment is maintained without spondylolisthesis. Mild multilevel lower lumbar facet arthropathy is present. Mild degenerative changes of the sacroiliac joints are noted. No acute osseous abnormality of the lumbar spine.
Mild multilevel degenerative disc disease with disc space narrowing and small endplate osteophytes, greatest at L4‑L5 and L5‑S1. The remaining disc spaces are preserved.
Moderate retained colonic stool burden is noted.

impression:

3. Mild levoconvex lumbar scoliosis.
4. Mild degenerative changes of the sacroiliac joints.
